scientific_integrity: No claim to authorship or independent mathematical certification. Acyclic graph matchings, face counts and graph parameters are checked in standalone source files; independent external audit has not been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Finite statements only for two explicit 16-vertex graphs. No extension to all strongly regular graphs or larger Doob graphs is proved; bibliographic uniqueness beyond inspected sources is not guaranteed. The proof invokes a standard finite discrete-Morse theorem in addition to an exhaustive computer-verifiable acyclicity certificate.
title: Independence complexes of the Shrikhande and \(4\times4\) rook graphs have different sphere-wedge homotopy types
